concerns.text: The output file `raw_snippets.jsonl` is described without mentioning the required `snippet_id` field defined in the Data Model (`CodeSnippet`). This creates a mismatch with the `CodeSnippet` schema which mandates a `snippet_id` (UUID).

The description of `llm_comments.jsonl` omits the `snippet_id` column required by the `CommentVariant` entity in the Data Model. Without this identifier the downstream joins (metrics, analysis) cannot be reliably performed.

The plan refers to loading external CSV files and merging them into `analysis_dataset.csv`, but does not explicitly reference the `human_study_responses.csv` file defined in the Data Model as the source of `HumanEvaluation` records. This omission reduces traceability between the plan and the data model.
